text: Endoderm [Gr. endon , inner, + derma , layer]: Ger. inneres Keimblatt ; Fr. endoderme ; Ital. endoderma or entoderma . The inner layer of coelenterate animals, or the inner of the two primitive cell-layers of the embryo mammal, often termed hypoblast. See BLASTODERM, EMBRYO, and HYPOBLAST. ( C.LL.M. - E.S.G. )
